experiment_data.hypothesis: DeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned ordinal classifier as upper-bound baseline for 15D handcrafted features: if DeBERTa also yields K*=2 on C4 depth chains, the saturation boundary is near-intrinsic to generation process rather than a feature ceiling; if K*=3+, quantifies the gap between handcrafted and neural representations. Uses same 5-fold GroupKFold, pairwise AUC evaluation, θ=0.60 K* criterion.

spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && python scripts/run_deberta_upperbound.py
